description: An object whose contents can change in place: `list`, `dict`, `set` and most class instances.
An object that never changes after creation: `int`, `str`, `tuple`, `frozenset`, `None`. Operations return new objects.
Has a stable `__hash__` consistent with `__eq__`. Required for dict keys and set members. Lists, dicts and sets are not hashable.
An immutable, hashable set. Equality ignores order.
A tuple cannot change its slots, but a mutable object stored inside can still change; such a tuple is not hashable.
